visible.title: Bad message format: Tried to use SessionInfo before it was initialized
visible.body:
### Checklist

### Summary

The following issue does not seem to be resolved or is manifesting from a different root cause.
[https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/9767](url)

Within the last couple of weeks, the "Bad message format" popup started appearing in my commercial application that uses Streamlit for the UI. We have not deployed a new version, changed the Docker container, or changed the application hosting. The Bad message format was not a problem before. 

Once the dialog box is cleared, there is no issue with the application running as normal. *Is this notification needed on the front end at all???*

I have tried multiple solutions with session_state variables, loading delays, and configuration file updates, but nothing I have tried resolves the error. 

I have no idea how to go about replicating this with a simpler code. While i cannot share my commercial codebase here, I would be happy to privately share on a screenshare with a developer working on the bug.

Please see additional details below. @user
 

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python

```

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Start a session of the application BargeAI at https://barge-ai.com with a browser OR refresh the browser 
2. Login (or cookies activated)
3. Wait for the application to load
4. Bad message format dialog box appears
5. Close Bad message format dialog box
6. Application runs normally

[image]

### Expected Behavior

Steps 4 & 5 above would not happen

### Current Behavior

ERROR MESSAGE:
"Bad message format: Tried to use SessionInfo before it was initialized"
[image]

CONSOLE:
Here is the corresponding error message from the console.
index.DmrHunjf.js:811 Error: Tried to use SessionInfo before it was initialized
    at get current (index.DmrHunjf.js:735:48883)
    at App.handlePageProfileMsg (index.DmrHunjf.js:811:24732)
    at Object.pageProfile (index.DmrHunjf.js:811:22384)
    at Me (index.DmrHunjf.js:811:21802)
    at App.handleMessage [as onMessage] (index.DmrHunjf.js:811:21864)
    at WebsocketConnection.handleMessage (index.DmrHunjf.js:762:2855)

ELASTIC BEANSTALK DOCKER CONTAINER LOG:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/tornado/websocket.py", line 1113, in wrapper
    await fut
tornado.iostream.StreamClosedError: Stream is closed

During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/tornado/websocket.py", line 1115, in wrapper
    raise WebSocketClosedError()
tornado.websocket.WebSocketClosedError
Task exception was never retrieved
future: <Task finished name='Task-151850' coro=<WebSocketProtocol13.write_message.<locals>.wrapper() done, defined at /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/tornado/websocket.py:1111> exception=WebSocketClosedError()>

ADDITIONAL INFO:
The dialog box does not appear every time a new session is created but the occurrence is now frequent. It seems like the websocket may be disconnecting periodically with this new paradigm. Occasionally, in the upper right hand corner, I see the word "CONNECTION" or "CONNECTING" appear just before the message appears, which seems to signify that the websocket was disconnected. 

### Is this a regression?

- [x] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.41.0
- Python version: python:3.11-slim
- Operating System: Docker running on 64bit Amazon Linux 2023/4.5.2 (AWS Elastic Beanstalk, EC2)
- Browser: Chrome Version 136.0.7103.114 (Official Build) (x86_64)

### Additional Information

Most recent related issue:
[https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/9767]

gold.summary: SessionInfo initialization popup on reported Streamlit 1.41.0 with reconnect symptoms.
hypotheses: after upgrade: ForwardMsg MISS known in 1.45.0, fixed 1.45.1
acceptable_next_steps: Explain the earlier documented SessionInfo fix and test an appropriate later patch.
If it persists, collect reconnect/server logs and a minimal reproducer without assuming every similarly worded popup has the same cause.
must_not: Use 1.43.2 correction or the later screenshot as initial facts.
Guarantee upgrading fixes every reconnect problem.
gold.reference: Maintainer: fix is in a later release; after correction & upgrade to 1.45.0 user hit ForwardMsg MISS -> 1.45.1 fixed it.
gold.review_reason: Earlier release evidence for the SessionInfo race supports known_issue on reported 1.41.0. Later correction to 1.43.2 and the new ForwardMsg error must be confined to follow-up state.

acceptable_next_steps: Explain patch landed in a later version (release notes 1.45.0) and recommend upgrading to latest patch (>=1.45.1)
draft.summary: 'Bad message format: SessionInfo before it was initialized' popup in production, user states 1.41.0 (later corrected to 1.43.2).
